title: specularia vulgaris
intro: Specularia vulgaris, commonly known as the American Foxglove or American Foxglove Beardtongue, is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic to treat digestive issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Specularia vulgaris include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relaxing the muscles, reducing inflammation, and modulating the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Specularia vulgaris also include its sedative and antiseptic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and wound healing.
